tokens.name: hc-color-surface-base
tokens.usage: App background behind everything (Midnight #0E1620 · Daybreak #F2F5F8 · Graphite #080B10). v1 role color.surface.base.

tokens.name: hc-color-surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and global header ground. Slightly lifted from surface-base so the shell frames the workspace without a heavy border.

tokens.name: hc-color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table bodies, dialogs' content area. v1 role color.surface.raised.

tokens.name: hc-color-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces: menus, popovers, command palette, dialogs, sticky table headers. v1 role color.surface.overlay.

tokens.name: hc-color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a panel: log viewers, code blocks, input grounds in Midnight/Graphite. v1 role color.surface.sunken.

tokens.name: hc-color-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: hc-color-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current nav item, the active drive bay. Always paired with a non-color cue (check, edge bar, aria-selected).

tokens.name: hc-color-input-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of text inputs, selects, comboboxes and checkboxes. Recessed in the dark themes, white in Daybreak so fields never look disabled. Always with a border-strong edge.

tokens.name: hc-color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and data text on every surface-* token (11:1+ in all themes).

tokens.name: hc-color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, column headers, timestamps, help text on every surface-* token (4.6:1+ in all themes).

tokens.name: hc-color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only. Exempt from contrast minimums, so always pair a disabled control with a visible reason (disabledReason).

tokens.name: hc-color-text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a solid text-primary fill (tooltips).

tokens.name: hc-color-text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links on surface-base, surface-raised and surface-overlay (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Separation hairlines: panel edges, row rules, dividers. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: hc-color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons) and bay outlines: 3:1+ on surface-base, -raised and -overlay in every theme.

tokens.name: hc-color-accent-base
tokens.usage: Primary accent: primary button fill, current-nav edge bar, selected segment, chart series 1, progress fills. Midnight #4ED4C8 · Daybreak #167E82 · Graphite #C7D8EE.

tokens.name: hc-color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of accent-base surfaces.

tokens.name: hc-color-accent-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-base or accent-hover fills (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent-marked areas: selected segment track, info-neutral chips, drag targets. Text on it uses text-primary.

tokens.name: hc-color-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary accent (Midnight #567CE5 · Daybreak #4568BD · Graphite #6FA0EB): chart series 2, secondary data marks, VM/network glyphs. Not for text on dark grounds; use accent-secondary-text.

tokens.name: hc-color-accent-secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary accent as text or small icons on surface-base/raised/overlay (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Visible focus: a 2px outline offset 2px on every interactive element. 3:1+ against every surface in every theme (Graphite uses the warning yellow so focus is never confused with the pale accent).

tokens.name: hc-color-status-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy/running/success marks: dots, meter fills, icons (3:1+ on surface-raised). Pair with a check glyph and a word.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-warn
tokens.usage: Warning marks: dots, meter fills, icons. Daybreak's #B17A26 is 3.7:1 on white, fine for marks but not text: use status-warn-text for words.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-crit
tokens.usage: Critical/failed/destructive marks: dots, meter fills, danger-button fill, risk borders. Pair with an octagon glyph and a word.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-info
tokens.usage: Informational marks: info banners, running jobs, notices.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-unknown
tokens.usage: Unknown/unavailable state marks (no data, capability missing).

tokens.name: hc-color-status-ok-text
tokens.usage: Success words on surface-base, surface-raised and status-ok-subtle (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-status-warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning words on surface-base, surface-raised and status-warn-subtle (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-status-crit-text
tokens.usage: Error words on surface-base, surface-raised and status-crit-subtle (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-status-info-text
tokens.usage: Info words on surface-base, surface-raised and status-info-subtle (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: hc-color-status-warn-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on a solid status-warn fill.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-ok-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of success pills and banners.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-warn-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of warning pills, banners and risk callouts.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-crit-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of error pills, failed-row tint, destructive previews.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of info pills, banners and running-job rows.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on solid status-ok, status-crit or status-info fills (danger button label).

tokens.name: hc-color-meter-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled meter and progress track. Every status fill and accent-base reads 3:1+ on it.

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (= accent).

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (= secondary accent).

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5.

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6. Series are ordered; charts with more than 6 series fall back to a table view.

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: hc-color-chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart axis labels and ticks (4.5:1+ on surface-raised).

tokens.name: hc-color-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modal dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: hc-color-ink
tokens.usage: M1 compatibility alias for --hc-color-ink (frontend/design-system/tokens.css), per docs/ui/02 §2.6. Lets today's styles.css render in HCIS unchanged. New code uses hc-color-surface-base.

tokens.name: hc-color-panel
tokens.usage: M1 compatibility alias for --hc-color-panel (frontend/design-system/tokens.css), per docs/ui/02 §2.6. Lets today's styles.css render in HCIS unchanged. New code uses hc-color-surface-raised.

tokens.usage: M1 compatibility alias for --hc-color-focus (frontend/design-system/tokens.css), per docs/ui/02 §2.6. Lets today's styles.css render in HCIS unchanged. New code uses hc-color-focus-ring.

tokens.name: hc-color-glass-surface
tokens.usage: Translucent ground of glass surfaces: global header, sidebar, summary panels, floating inspectors. Alpha = the theme's glass opacity (Midnight 85%, Daybreak 90%, Graphite 95%), set so text-secondary still reads 4.5:1 even over the brightest unblurred content behind it.

tokens.name: hc-color-glass-surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Glass for floating layers: menus, popovers, the command palette and non-destructive dialogs (92–98% opaque). Destructive dialogs are never glass.

tokens.name: hc-color-glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge on glass surfaces; catches light like a desktop panel edge. Decorative: controls inside still use border-strong.

tokens.name: hc-color-glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight on glass panels (inset 0 1px). None in Graphite.

tokens.name: hc-color-glass-fallback
tokens.usage: Opaque substitute for glass-surface when backdrop blur is unsupported or the user chooses reduced transparency. Text passes 4.5:1 on it in every theme.

tokens.name: hc-color-backdrop-tint-1
tokens.usage: Soft teal glow in the app background behind glass (top-left). Off in Graphite.

tokens.name: hc-color-backdrop-tint-2
tokens.usage: Soft blue glow in the app background behind glass (bottom-right). Off in Graphite.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-notice
tokens.usage: Notice findings (worth knowing, not a problem). Shares the info hue; always labelled “Notice”.

tokens.name: hc-color-status-unknown-text
tokens.usage: “Unknown / not checked” words. Never shown in a healthy colour: an unchecked system is not a healthy one.

tokens.name: hc-color-scrim-critical
tokens.usage: Heavier backdrop behind destructive confirmation dialogs; no blur so the warning is never washed out.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Resource header names (host, pool, container). One per view; the HCIS successor of the M1 faceplate hostname.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sign in to manage this server.
styles.usage: Default UI text (14px). Numbers use tabular-nums everywhere.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, current nav item, row headers, emphasized values.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Dense table cells, secondary lines, toolbar fields.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, help text, pill labels, axis labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, property names in dense lists, column headers in forms.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels and table group rows, set uppercase. Never for sentences.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI figures on cards and the health dashboard; tabular-nums.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, unit names, IDs (WWN, serial, UUID), commands, config snippets.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Log entries in LogViewer and journal excerpts.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: TerminalViewer output and command transcripts; prompts in text-secondary, commands in text-primary.

fontSize.note: Raw --hc-font-size-* scale (rem, so user font-size settings apply). v1 names size.xs … size.display.

tokens.name: hc-font-size-xs
tokens.usage: Captions, pills.

tokens.name: hc-font-size-sm
tokens.usage: Dense tables, mono.

tokens.name: hc-font-size-md
tokens.usage: Body.

tokens.name: hc-font-size-lg
tokens.usage: Section headings.

tokens.name: hc-font-size-xl
tokens.usage: Page titles.

tokens.name: hc-font-size-display
tokens.usage: Resource header names.

tokens.name: hc-font-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body, cells.

tokens.name: hc-font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Captions, pills.

tokens.name: hc-font-weight-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, buttons, emphasis.

spacing.note: 4px grid: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64. Names keep the M1 convention (number = multiples of 4px), so hc-space-1…8 stay valid.

tokens.name: hc-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: hc-space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; cell padding (compact).

tokens.name: hc-space-3
tokens.usage: Control inline padding; cell padding (standard).

tokens.name: hc-space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (standard); gap between form rows.

tokens.name: hc-space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding (spacious); card grid gap.

tokens.name: hc-space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; page gutter (standard).

tokens.name: hc-space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter (spacious); dialog padding.

tokens.name: hc-space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: hc-space-12
tokens.usage: Header height; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: hc-space-16
tokens.usage: Large empty states and onboarding.

tokens.name: hc-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: buttons, pills, tags, checkboxes, segments, menu items.

tokens.name: hc-radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, search fields, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: hc-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, banners, table containers, drive bays.

tokens.name: hc-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Major containers: dialogs, command palette, resource headers, the bay chassis.

tokens.name: hc-radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots and switch tracks only.

density.note: Density is a user layout preference (docs/ui/06 §6.5, ADR 0010), never theme content. Apply with data-hc-density on the shell; bundle.css maps these to --hc-row-h, --hc-control-h, --hc-cell-py, --hc-cell-px, --hc-gap.

tokens.name: hc-density-compact-row
tokens.usage: Compact: table row height (meets the 24px WCAG 2.2 target minimum).

tokens.name: hc-density-compact-control
tokens.usage: Compact: button/input height.

tokens.name: hc-density-compact-pad
tokens.usage: Compact: cell block padding.

tokens.name: hc-density-standard-row
tokens.usage: Standard (default): table row height.

tokens.name: hc-density-standard-control
tokens.usage: Standard: button/input height.

tokens.name: hc-density-standard-pad
tokens.usage: Standard: cell block padding.

tokens.name: hc-density-spacious-row
tokens.usage: Spacious: table row height; matches the 44px touch target.

tokens.name: hc-density-spacious-control
tokens.usage: Spacious: button/input height.

tokens.name: hc-density-spacious-pad
tokens.usage: Spacious: cell block padding.

shadow.note: Subtle elevation for Midnight and Daybreak; Graphite separates with borders. Every elevated surface also keeps a border-subtle edge.

tokens.name: hc-shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised panel: cards and panels on the page (with a border-subtle edge). Graphite uses borders only.

tokens.name: hc-shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating panel and popover: menus, dropdowns, tooltips, floating inspectors, sticky headers when scrolled.

tokens.name: hc-shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialog: dialogs and the command palette over scrim. Graphite replaces it with a 1px border-strong ring.

tokens.name: hc-shadow-4
tokens.usage: Critical overlay: destructive confirmation dialogs. Opaque surface, critical-coloured ring, over scrim-critical.

tokens.name: hc-shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels: inner top highlight plus a soft drop so the layer reads as floating.

tokens.name: hc-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Box-shadow form of the focus indicator for elements where an outline is clipped (segments, table cells). Default focus is outline: 2px solid focus-ring, offset 2px.

glass.note: Glass is optional. Turn it off with data-hc-transparency="reduced" (a user preference) or prefers-reduced-transparency; solid hc-color-glass-fallback is used, and also where backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tokens.name: hc-glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for header, sidebar and summary panels.

tokens.name: hc-glass-blur-strong
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for menus, popovers, palette and dialogs.

tokens.name: hc-glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost so colour under glass stays legible, not muddy.

duration.note: Motion durations; prefers-reduced-motion or data-hc-motion="none" sets them to 0ms (bundle.css).

tokens.name: hc-motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, toggles, row highlights.

tokens.name: hc-motion-normal
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, panel slide, progress width.

tokens.name: hc-motion-slow
tokens.usage: Drawer and dialog entry only. Nothing longer.

tokens.name: hc-motion-ease
tokens.usage: Standard deceleration curve for all transitions.

textScale.note: Text size is a user accessibility preference, independent of colour themes and fonts. The app sets the root font size to the chosen percentage; every type token is in rem, so all text scales and layouts reflow. Browser zoom and OS font-size settings still apply on top.

tokens.name: hc-text-scale-90
tokens.usage: Smaller: dense monitoring on large displays. Never below 90%.

tokens.name: hc-text-scale-100
tokens.usage: Default: follows the browser's base size (normally 16px; body text is 14px).

tokens.name: hc-text-scale-112
tokens.usage: Larger: laptops at a distance, tired eyes.

tokens.name: hc-text-scale-125
tokens.usage: Largest preset. Layouts must stay usable here and at 200% browser zoom (WCAG 1.4.4).
